Higher ranking members are known as Adepts and have uniforms that appear to feature more of the same animal, such as Zilu, whose outfit possesses two hares as opposed to the regular Mao Branch members' singular hare, as well as dual wielding a personal blade and the standard-issue Mao Branch's "Butcherblade".

The exact nature of each Branch varies depending on the nature of said Branch, generally ranging from private army to a "secret service".

Mao Branch: The Mao Branch (卯; pinyin: mǎo), colloquially known as 'hares', specialize in group ambush and pursuit missions. The Mao's mutations are based on hares, allowing them to transform their legs into digitigrade limbs to massively enhance their speed and agility.

Their weaponry consists of a long and thin rectangular greatsword with glyphs inscribed onto them using Q Corp.'s Singularity, which grants them additional power when a certain pre-determined condition is met.

The Mao Branch is currently in service to Jia Qiu and his clan, and were temporarily loaned to Shi Yihua during the events of Intervallo V: Nocturnal Sweeping.

Si Branch: The Si Branch (巳; pinyin: sì), colloquially known as 'serpents', specialize in assassination and stealth, wielding thin purple spears. The Si Branch's mutuations are based on snakes, and transform their limbs into thin, scaled forms resembling snakes, which allows them to strike with blinding speed and attack from unconventional angles.

They currently appear to be in service to the Shi family.

Other Branches: 

Several other Branches have been alluded to or directly shown, but not extensively elaborated on:

The Zi Branch (子; pinyin: zǐ), presumably based on rats, which is mentioned to mobilize in large groups.
The Chou Branch (丑; pinyin: chǒu), based on oxen, which is in service to the position of Family Hierarch. They appear to wield large, spiked clubs.
The Shen Branch (申; pinyin: shēn), based on monkeys, which is in service to the position of Family Hierarch. They appear to wield staffs.
The Chen Branch (辰; pinyin: chén), based on dragons, which is in service to the position of Family Hierarch.
The You Branch (酉; pinyin: yǒu), based on roosters, said to specialize in direct combat and warfare rather than subterfuge. They appear to be in service to the Jia family.
The Wei Branch (未; pinyin: wèi), based on goats, which is only alluded to by Jia Mu's skills.
The Yin Branch (寅; pinyin: yín), based on tigers, which is only alluded to by Jia Mu's skills.
An unnamed branch based on horses, presumably called the Wu Branch (午; pinyin: wǔ), which Wei is implied to be a former Adept of.

Members:
Zilu - (Mao Branch Adept),
Wei - (Former Wu Branch Adept).

entries.name: Sweeper Fuel Cylinder
entries.content: These fuel cylinders contain the energy source for the Sweepers, who cleanse the City every Night in the Backstreets. Despite the nightly chaos, people step out each morning to pristine streets on their way to work—all thanks to the Sweepers. Using their fluid fuel, they dissolve anything that doesn't belong in the City, from street litter to unauthorized structures, as they flood the streets at night. Like clockwork, they emerge from the subterranean depths beneath the City every night. I do wonder, though—just how deep do they come from? - Excerpt from an interview with an LCCB Employee

entries.name: Sweeper Fuel Tank
entries.content: Much about the Sweepers remains a mystery. When did they first begin their nightly labors? Where do they come from? It is said that the only institution they cooperate with is the Head. The Sweepers’ fluid fuel is a multifunctional resource—it forms their bodies, serves as a weapon to dissolve whatever lies in their path, and sustains them. This is merely a personal curiosity, but I cannot help but wonder how they propagate. Perhaps they are the culprits behind reports of children vanishing during Nights in the Backstreets… or kidnappings from the Outskirts - Excerpt from an interview with an LCCA Employee

entries.name: Jia Family
entries.content:
The Jia family is a powerful family at the head of Hongyuan, which Hong Lu hails from. The Jia family is the most prestigious of the houses of Daguanyuan, their power having remained great and stable for many decades, despite their glory having been overshadowed by the Kong Family for a certain period, around two decades prior to the events of the main story.

As the most prominent family of Daguanyuan, the Jia family presented a great number of candidates for the Family Hierarch Evaluation. Among them, notable ones are Jia Huan, Jia Xichun, the Kong family remnant Jia Qiu, and the surprise entry Jia Baoyu, jade of the family. All four passed the first round of evaluation and survived the second. Jia Xichun placed first and obtained the title of Family Hierarch, with Jia Baoyu and Jia Huan respectively placing second and third.

Following Jia Xichun's victory, Jia Yuanchun conspired, together with the Shi and Xue families, to overthrow the results and seize the power in Hongyuan by force. After the conspiracy failed and Jia Xichun ascended to the throne, Jia Yuanchun made herself scarce.

Family:

Jia Baoyu / Hong Lu - (Member),
Jia Xichun - (Family Hierarch, H Corp. Executive Director),
Jia Huan - (Member),
Jia Mu - (Former Family Hierarch),
Jia Qiu - (Member),
Jia Yuanchun - (Q Corp. affiliate),
Jia Zheng - (Jia Baoyu's father),
Lady Wang - (Jia Baoyu's mother).

Retainers (non-relatives):

Wei - (Jia Xichun's servant),
Zigong - (Jia Qiu's student),
Xiren - (Hong Lu's servant),
Qingtao - (Former Jia family servant).

entries.name: Tri-axe Office
entries.content:
The Tri-axe Office is a Fixer Office located in the Backstreets of District 8. As its name implies, Fixers of this Office wield hatchets as their primary weapons. The Office uniform consists of a dark outfit including a hat and changpao with silver fastenings below the collar.

Members:

Shan San.

entries.name: Burning Duchess
entries.content:
An abnormality.

It appears to be a female humanoid in a flaming dress, holding an ornate fan and wearing a mask. Its lower body beneath the skirt appears to be a cage, within which are multiple chains and burnt, chained hands.

The Abnormality appears to have a relation to ducks, which it appears alongside with in its E.G.O.

Burning Duchess appears to be based on witch trials where individual suspected of using witchcraft would be burned at the stake. Specifically be based on the witch trial scene from Monty Python and the Holy Grail, where it is posited that a person can be determined to be a witch if they weigh the same as a duck.

The Indicant's Trial E.G.O is extracted from Burning Duchess.

entries.name: Indicant's Trial
entries.content:
The E.G.O extracted from the abnormality Burning Duchess.

The user wears a fancy red and grey gown covered in roses of the same colour, cuffs and lower parts of the outfit are burning and the user has cutlery in their hands. A large red knot adorned with red and white roses rests on top of the user's head.

The targets of the E.G.O are put on a stage that looks like it came from a picture book, the target is then weighed as 3 ducks jump onto the other side of the scale, equalising the scale. Once this happens the target is then hanged with metal chains and then burned before the curtains close.

entries.name: HamHamPangPang
entries.content: HamHamPangPang is a sandwich franchise originating from District 13 that has slowly expanded to every district. Roland is an avid enjoyer of the chain, saying that it has improved the quality of life in the Backstreets.

entries.name: Nuanxiangwu
entries.content: Jia Xichun's personal building / residence within Daguanyuan in Hongyuan.

entries.name: Lei Heng
entries.content:
Lei Heng is a Capo IIII of the Thumb, ranked directly beneath the Sottocapo, who knew Ryōshū in the past by the name "Yoshihide".

Lei Heng is an imposing man of strong build and tall stature, seemingly surpassing two meters. He has a tan complexion and brown eyes. He has slick black hair that reaches his shoulders, parted in the middle and partially tied back in a ponytail, and with a dyed golden strand on the left. Lei Heng sports some stubble, and is seen smoking a cigar.

Lei Heng dons an outfit of the Thumb, consisting of rose-red trousers, a matching jacket with four golden bars over his left lapel, over a brown shirt with an open collar and golden fastenings. Over his shoulders, he wears a long, oversized jacket that matches his suit, and wears brown gloves. He carries a large podao that features exhaust pipes for the use of propellants, attached to his hip through an ammunition belt around his waist.

As a high ranking member of the Thumb, Lei Heng has a nonchalant demeanor, being used to receiving respect and carrying no regard for those beneath him. He appears confident in his role and comfortable in most situations, talking to Ryōshū in a casual way despite her obvious dislike for him, going as far as to speak down to her, knowing full well the Sinner wouldn't be able to retaliate against someone like him.

Lei Heng attended the Family Hierarch Evaluation of Hongyuan, being affiliated in some way with one of the candidates that was attempting to become the next Hierarch. During the first Evaluation, he spotted Ryōshū in the crowd and walked over to say greet her, as he had not seen her in a long time. Before he reached the Sinners, Faust quickly urged Dante and the others to not speak to Lei Heng or look at him directly, as they were all too low ranking to speak to such a high ranking member of the Thumb. Unfortunately, an attendant of the Nangong family, one of the houses that was attending the Evaluation, was not aware of Lei Heng's rank and began to scold him for getting in the way of his master's view of the ongoing Evaluation. As is typical with a member of the Thumb, Lei Heng wasted no time punishing the attendant for this lack of respect, and sliced his arm off before proceeding to rip out the man's tongue. He then approached Nangong Xianhe, the young master of the Nangong family, and broke his hand off of his arm, mentioning that he was going easy on the young master due to being in a good mood from seeing Ryōshū.

After handling the infraction, Lei Heng then caught up with Ryōshū, all while Ryōshū had to restrain her urge to attack him. Only Faust's reminders that Ryōshū needed to wait long and remember the promise she made upon her employment to Limbus Company were enough to stop a fight from breaking out between the two. Lei Heng made several remarks about his shared past with Ryōshū, implying that he taught her how to use a sword and that the two were once worked together. He also asked if her "baby" was still at the Spider's House, a place Ryōshū used to frequent and that Lei Heng still stops by when he has to, which almost made Ryōshū unsheathe her sword in anger. Before she could be further tempted to attack him, Lei Heng received a call from the Sottocapo and had to leave to answer it. As he left, he promised that they would meet again later to talk more, and in the process referred to to Ryōshū as "Yoshihide".

During the attempted coup against Jia Xichun making use of a power vacuum while she visits the Xianren, Lei Heng accompanies a faction of the Thumb that arrived to District 8, including his Sottocapo. While he was ordered to, alongside his men, stop Jia Xichun from reaching the Tiekan Temple and kill her prior to that, he failed. Deciding to accommodate this failure, he massacred Xichun's men, brutally maiming Wei likewise. Zilu would exchange herself to take a singular blow from Lei Heng, his promise being that Wei will be allowed to leave afterwards. Utilizing his newly learned Shin, he struck Zilu diagonally across her chest with a singular ring of Mang, nearly killing her even while she used Shin as protection. A man of his word, he kicked Wei to the Sinners, preparing himself to slaughter the rest of them. While the first moments of battle are one-sided, Lei Heng was brought to the level of the Sinners due to Dante's newfound Golden Bough resonance; despite the difficulty in now being more likely to struggle, Lei Heng acknowledges and admires the gamble. Even still, he proved too powerful and skilled for the group and nearly eradicated them, remarking that the Sinners would have won had Ryōshū unsheathed her blade, right before Jia Qiu arrived. Taking over the battle from here, he and Zilu battle the Thumb, managing the Capo while holding him off.

As the Sinners return from their business inside the chamber, Lei Heng is all that remains of the Thumb forces. Realizing his status as both heavily wounded and outnumbered, he attempts to plead for his life, willing to grant what is needed to allow him to leave, if Jia Qiu wills it. In accordance, Jia Qiu offers him the same treatment as what he gave Zilu - a single blow he may survive. Lei Heng, understanding this implication, took a new cigar from his pocket and took a drag from it. With Jia Qiu's staff placed atop his right shoulder, he generated five rings of Mang. After taking one last reverent drag from his cigarette, defeatedly claiming "Hit me", his head is obliterated, raining gore upon all present as the pieces of his skull are sent flying.

After his death, his status as a member of the Pinky is discussed. Within the Pinky, he was known as the Winged Tiger and held the seat of the Tiantui Star, which is now vacant following his death. Whether his status as a member of a rival Finger was known to the Thumb or not is unknown.

entries.name: Shi Sijing
entries.content:
Shi Sijing is a member of the Shi Family, as well as one of the many Family Hierarch Evaluation candidates competing for the role of Hierarch in District 8.

Shi Sijing is a burly man with dull brown hair that extends to his collarbone, where the tips have a green gradient. His bangs are parted in the center, revealing a stalwart expression with his eyes closed, and several circuitry wires lining his cheeks and forehead, traveling down his neck. He wears a green robe with a yellow inner robe and sash, the right arm of his robes rolled up to reveal a muscular arm covered with circuitry similar to those on his face. His feet are uncovered and plain.

Shi Sijing is a brutal man, willing to sacrifice his men for experimenting in ways to ensure his own safety. He treats others as trash, discarding them as they lose their use. He is shown to be spiteful towards Hong Lu due to the latter's easy life.

Shi Sijing participated in the Family Hierarch Evaluations. He succeeded in the first round, and was met in the second round. During this, he encountered Hong Lu and his entourage while Sijin was busy checking the status of one of his men, afflicted by madness. Deeming the man no longer worth keeping around, he would have him executed, turning his attention to Hong Lu. Malaising on how many "servants" Hong Lu still has, Shi Sijing makes it known how effective he views sacrificing those he deems to be lesser. Following the short discussion, he attacked Hong Lu, all the while allowing his men to take fatal blows for him, though he fell regardless. In his defeat, Shi Sijing refused to allow for his enemy to claim his coins, and chose to forfeit moments before it happened.

entries.name: Shi Huazhen
entries.content:
Shi Huazhen is a member of the Shi Family, as well as one of the many Family Hierarch Evaluation candidates competing for the role of Hierarch in District 8.

Shi Huazhen is a shorter man with black hair, accented by two prominent blue streaks, and similarly colored eyes. He wears a fancy blue robe, over a changpao of the same color, his hands jammed into his pockets. He wears simple black, baggy pants and black shoes.

In combat, he carries a podao that has a golden circuitry pattern along its blade.

Shi Huazhen is hotheaded, and views himself as better than others. His cocky nature is shown when he refers to Jia Baoyu as a thing, and tries to hint him into remembering his name after he forgot.

Shi Huazhen participated in the Family Hierarch Evaluations. He succeeded in the first round, and was met in the second round. During the encounter, he met Hong Lu and his faction early on, aiming to eliminate them and steal their coins quickly. He become irate at Hong Lu's unexpected alliance with Wang Zhao, and even angrier when Hong Lu failed to remember his name, attempting to clue him in on it. After losing to the Sinners, Shi Huazhen would be eliminated from the second round, and Hong Lu would manage to remember his name.

entries.name: Wang Zhao
entries.content:
Wang Zhao is a member of the Wang Family, as well as one of the many Family Hierarch Evaluation candidates competing for the role of Hierarch in District 8.

Wang Zhao is a short man with cropped black hair, with his bangs shaped in cloud-like formations, sweeping to the left side of his face. He wears a small gilded crown, and has half-lidded eyes, with yellow irises and purple pupils. His hair extends behind his neck, connecting into a braid that rests across his collar. He wears a choker with a similar intricate design to his crown, and a cropped white jacket with a cloud pattern along the sleeves. Beneath this, he wears a gray top buttoned beneath a braided cross-pattern belt, which extends into a long tailcoat with the same cloud pattern as his top. His pants are white, becoming dark gray with a gradient, and he wears dark loafers on his feet. On the left side of his waist, he carries a white-and-gray sword with a gilded hilt, and carries an ornate pipe in his right hand, featuring a cloud of dark smoke emerging.

Wang Zhao is a lax man without aspirations to acquire the title of Hongyuan hierarch, rather participating to find another candidate that is more deserving of the title, giving them his backing. He is a self-admitted introvert, preferring to remain in his quarters more commonly, contributing to his distance among even other Daguanyuan residents such as Hong Lu.

Wang Zhao participated in the Family Hierarch Evaluations. In the first round, he witnessed Dante reviving Hong Lu after being split in half by Ryōshū. He succeeded in the first round, and was met face-to-face in the second round. At the beginning of the second round, he approached Hong Lu and his entourage, interested in a temporary travelling group to spectate the man. While the group was initially skeptical of the man's intent, he willingly clarified that he would only be following others to find a candidate he deemed worth supporting, having no interest in the role of hierarch himself. Sacrificing a coin of his, he accompanied the group to their agreeance. In the midst of their early travels, he questioned Hong Lu about the rumor of Jia Xichun having lost her Heishou Pack, mentioning he may give up another coin in favor of the information, though was disappointed when Hong Lu could not offer any answer. After a brief battle with Shi Huazhen, and examination of the old Kong Family laboratory, Wang Zhao deemed he had seen enough, and that Hong Lu is not who he plans to assist. Saying goodbye, he casually severed the agreeance on accompanying one another, and wandered off.

On his own, he would be willingly eliminated by giving his coins to Jia Qiu, who promised all that he wished for. While waiting for his elimation to be confirmed, Jia Huan came across him, shocked that he would give up that easily - especially for somebody like Jia Qiu. While Jia Huan considered brutalizing the man then and there, the nearby Heishou Pack members took Wang Zhao out of the competition.

Briefly during Jia Xichun's celebration ceremony, Wang Zhao met again with the Sinners. Rather than joining the celebrations, he simply alluded to the storm clouds gathering over Hongyuan, in reference to both the external and internal forces looking to topple the status quo of the new hierarch. Concluding his brief reappearance, he left after the brief and ambiguous message.

entries.name: Wang Qingshan
entries.content:
Wang Qingshan is a member of the Wang Family, as well as one of the many Family Hierarch Evaluation candidates competing for the role of Hierarch in District 8.

Wang Qingshan wears her deep blue hair in a bowlcut fashion, with straight bangs around the entire perimeter of her head. She wears a brown kasaya, with an orange robe overtop fastened by a large golden buckle. On her feet, she wears plain brown sandals. When encountered, she is bloodied and in a kneeling position, her clothes partially torn. She carries a japamala in her right hand.

Desperately hoping to prove herself to her family, Wang Qingshan is a devout woman hoping to win the role of Hierarch, bringing honor to her family if she succeeds. Despite the fact that she fled from past battles, she is willing to battle while injured, hoping to simply prove herself as worth her weight.

Wang Qingshan participated in the Family Hierarch Evaluations. She succeeded in the first round, and was met in the second round, being first identified by Lin Daiyu. Here, she encountered Jia Qiu who bested her in combat, barely escaping his brutal attack. Begging Hong Lu for his coins, the rejection pushed her to fear for her life if she returned home a failure, leading her to attack Hong Lu and the Sinners with her remaining troops. Losing the short scuffle, she was shortly eliminated.

entries.name: Wang Dawei
entries.content:
Wang Dawei is a member of the Wang Family and a candidate of the Family Hierarch Evaluations, having colluded with Shi Yihua to secure the Hierarch role.

Wang Dawei is a tall man with medium length, middle-parted brown hair beneath a short, black, hat. He wears a simply charcoal blue robe that reaches his ankles, buttoned over the right side of his chest. On his back, he carries a large hourglass shaped coffin, with two straps on its back allowing it to rest on his shoulders.

Wang Dawei is coolheaded, choosing to slowly plan out his actions rather than charge into a battle without consideration. He believes himself to be intelligent, and is quick to mend any potential disadvantage he happens to brings himself, such as when he quickly segued a failed attempt to steal Jia Qiu's coins to stealing Jia Baoyu's instead.

Following the events of Intervallo V: Nocturnal Sweeping, Wang Dawei would, at some point, become acquainted with and revive Shi Yihua using newfound Wang Family Boluses.

During round one of the Family Hierarch Evaluation, Wang Dawei passed the first round by impressing the judges with his possible solution to immortality.

During the second round of the Family Hierarch Evaluation, he encountered Hong Lu and his entourage as they were meeting with Xue Baochai. Proclaiming his intention to swoop in and claim a success in the evaluation, he was allowed the chance to steal a portion of any one candidate's coins. While he initially spoke to steal Jia Qiu's coins, the host reminded him of the possible dangers of the target of the theft attacking him, to which he swiftly amended his target to be Hong Lu. Wang Dawei, having colluded with Shi Yihua for a new, unmarketed bolus made by the Wang Family, unleashed the revived Shi Family member from his coffin, acting as a surprise marketing reveal. Shi Yihua, failing to agree with his partner, chose to battle the Sinners out of personal spite and feelings of newfound power.

In the midst of the battle, stray pinions flew into and injured Wang Dawei. While his fate is unknown, Shi Yihua and Xue Baochai would continue battling until they were both eliminated, implying he was simply injured.

entries.name: Kong Youjin
entries.content:
Kong Youjin was a member of the Kong Family, a scientist, and the loving husband of Kong Sihui. He was pulled into a scheme by Jia Mu that ultimately lead to the Kong Family's downfall.

Kong Youjin is a tall man with long, brown hair pulled back into a long ponytail fastened by a silver xiao guan, with notably curly facial hair, such as eyebrows and a moustache which curl at their ends, as well as a long goatee. He wears a long pale blue robe overtop a darker robe, the pale blue robe having a floral trim along its inner lining and sleeves. On his feet, he wears similarly blue loafers.

Kong Youjin showed himself to be highly intelligent, heading a team of incredibly capable scientists among the Kong Family. Just as intelligent as he was, he cared greatly for his wife and unborn child, hoping for a great future for the people of Hongyuan.

Kong Youjin once met with Jia Mu, who established a plan to create a thirteenth Heishou Pack Branch, invented by a Bolus created by the Hierarch accompanied by the team of Kong Family scientists. In reality, this was a front, planned by Jia Mu to have the Kong Family annihilated. He would be thankful for a specialized Bolus given to his wife as supposedly a means to ensure good tidings for their unborn child.

At the day of the presentation, Kong Youjin and Sihui would sit front row for the presentation, yet would ultimately end up brutally killed by the combined efforts of the Jiajia-ren, Outskirts monsters propagated by Jia Mu's special Bolus given to Kong Sihui, and the Head arriving to kill the monsters.

Their history would be twisted into a sign of greed among the royal houses of Hongyuan, painting a false history of hubris.

The history of the Kong Family would be made known to the Sinners and Lin Daiyu, as Hong Lu experiences memories reemerging via the resonance of a nearby Golden Bough.

entries.name: Kong Sihui
entries.content:
Kong Sihui was a member of the Kong Family, a scientist, and the loving wife of Kong Youjin. She was pulled into a scheme by Jia Mu that ultimately lead to the Kong Family's downfall.

Kong Sihui is an older woman with brown hair tied into a bun, fastened by a floral ornament and pin keeping it in place. She has two thick strands of hair reaching from her forehead to the tops of her ears. She wears a pink-and-gold hanfu with ornate golden patterning on the sleeves, and a floral pattern along the hemline of the skirt. She wears a translucent, pale blue cloth overtop her outfit.

In the period leading up to her death, Kong Sihui was pregnant.

Kong Sihui was a very patient woman, interested in the sciences she participated in, assisting in resources for Jia Mu's experiments. She cared greatly for her husband and unborn child, hoping for a great future for the people of Hongyuan.

Kong Sihui once met with Jia Mu alongside Kong Youjin, who established a plan to create a thirteenth Heishou Pack Branch, invented by a Bolus created by the Hierarch accompanied by the team of Kong Family scientists. In reality, this was a front, planned by Jia Mu to have the Kong Family annihilated. Kong Sihui would be surprised with a specialized Bolus as supposedly a means to ensure good tidings for their unborn child.

At the day of the presentation, Kong Sihui and Youjin would sit front row for the presentation, yet would ultimately end up brutally killed by the combined efforts of the Jiajia-ren, Outskirts monsters propagated by Jia Mu's special Bolus given to Kong Sihui, and the Head arriving to kill the monsters.

Their history would be twisted into a sign of greed among the royal houses of Hongyuan, painting a false history of hubris.

The history of the Kong Family would be made known to the Sinners and Lin Daiyu, as Hong Lu experiences memories reemerging via the resonance of a nearby Golden Bough.

entries.name: Night Drifter
entries.content:
The Night Drifter is a drunken assassin working in District 8.

The Night Drifter is an elderly man with long gray hair tied behind his head, and a similarly gray beard on his chin, curling at the end. He wears a dingy straw hat with two hanging straps, as well as a large green scarf around his neck. Beneath this scarf, he wears a brown-and-gray hanfu, tied at the waist by a dark sash and ropes. His feet are wrapped in gray cloth, connected to similarly gray soles. He is seen wielding a wooden staff with a single leaf at its top, as well as a large orange drinking gourd with a small yellow sash tied at its middle.

The Night Drifter is a highly capable man, reacting laxly while carrying out his assassin work, confident he will succeed. He has a penchant for drinking, which allows for him to better handle his opponents. Like most of those working in line of the familial battles within Daguanyuan, he has little moral qualms with attacking unwilling combatants when ordered to.

Following the first round of the Family Hierarch Evaluation, Hong Lu and the Sinners returned to Baoyu's residence. Here, the Night Drifter, alongside a gang of podao-wielding assassins, broke into the residency through the roof. While the Sinners were capable of fending off several of the assassins, the Night Drifter joined the scuffle. Despite Outis attempting to gleam information from the man, he simply states that he has no name yet is known by others as the Night Drifter. Easily dispatching several of the Sinners, the Night Drifter crushes the brain of Hong Lu, lamenting that the victim may have been as skilled as himself, had Hong Lu been trained under his tutelage. Believing his job to be done, the Night Drifter, alongside the remaining assassins, then disappeared into the darkness.

He is later mentioned to have been among the assassins hired by the mother of Xue Baochai, looking to eliminate Hong Lu.

The Night Drifter's fighting style emulates the Chinese martial art of the Drunken Fist style.

entries.name: Jia Huan (Original)
entries.content:
The Jia Huan from Hong Lu's memories is the mysterious "bastard child" of the Jia family and younger brother of N Corp. Jia Huan, as well as the origin of his eventual namesake.

Jia Huan is a little boy with bright yellow eyes and light skin. He has long hair, which is a deep shade of purple parted down the middle, before tied up into a ponytail with a discolored yellow hair tie. He wears a blue hanfu, which features hints of a darker blue around his waist and wrists, and lighter blue where the design slits along his legs. His shoes are a similar dark blue color.

Jia Huan is a somewhat curious and oblivious boy. He maintains a friendly attitude with a tendency to poke fun at others, but is also shone to be prone to the small fits of pettiness, jealousy, and accidental insults that are common in children. Additionally, he is somewhat defined by his joyous passion for Bolus-making.

Jia Huan is described as having a "more precious" future in Daguanyuan than Hong Lu ever could have. He had a great interest in Boluses and their creation, which led him to envy his peer's Jia Baoyu's relationship with Jia Mu, the woman said to be the most knowledgeable Bolus creator in all of District 8. During their youths, Jia Huan was a friend and playmate of Hong Lu and Lin Daiyu.

When a young Hong Lu realized that something terrible was about to happen within the old Kong family building, he went around warning everyone he could to evacuate the area. This included Lin Daiyu and Jia Huan, however, only Lin Daiyu ended up listening to his plea. Led by his envy of Hong Lu and interest in Boluses, Jia Huan would stay to get a peek at the presentation. This led him to be caught in the grand crossfire that led to the destruction of the Kong family. Jia Huan ran into Jia Mu and Hong Lu before he died, where he begged for help and apologized for not listening to Hong Lu's warning. After his death, Jia Mu would criticize the young boy for his greed and refer to him as the "bastard son of the Jia family".

His older brother, the Jia Huan associated with the New League of Nine Littérateurs, would go on to despise Hong Lu for failing to "save" the child, and take on Jia Huan's name, for unknown reasons.

entries.name: Lin Daiyu
entries.content:
Lin Daiyu is a servant to the Xue family of Daguanyuan, and an old friend of Hong Lu.

Lin Daiyu is a pale woman with an agile build and large blue eyes. She has long dark blue hair, tied in a high ponytail with a golden ribbon. She wears a black hanfu with dark blue detailing, tied with a belt of golden rope. Notably, she has a small mole on the left side of her neck. In combat, she wields a spear.

In her youth, Lin Daiyu was a cheery child who acted atypically of those in Hongyuan, much to Jia Baoyu's confusion. Despite this, she was kind to him and the two would become intimate friends.

By the time of Canto VIII: The Surrendered Witnessing, she has become disillusioned with her friendship and solely worries about her duties serving Xue Baochai. She carries a guilt of being one of the sole survivors of the Kong family massacre, which leaves her awaiting a future of betterment idly, never acting on her own fate. This guilt and tension is only cleared as she comes to understand what Hong Lu went through, finally allowing her closure with the man.

In her youth, Lin Daiyu was incredibly close to Jia Baoyu and Jia Huan, acting as playmates as Huan's older brother watched over them. Lin Daiyu pushed Jia Baoyu to be more active in their playdates, urging him to reignite a love for toys and games, as his personality gradually decayed via the onslaught of terrible things he witnessed by Jia Mu's hand.

One day, Jia Baoyu warned her not to visit the Kong family's new invention, to which she listened after much convincing, while Jia Huan did not. After the deaths of those present at the celebration, Lin Daiyu was later found, cowering in a shed. She grew resentful of Jia Baoyu for having chosen only her as a survivor, never understanding the fact he attempted to convince Huan likewise, yet failed. This survivor's guilt would haunt her for the rest of her youth.

Lin Daiyu was first noticed by Hong Lu during the first round of the Family Hierarch Evaluation, where he spotted her in the crowd. While Hong Lu makes a friendly effort to greet her, Lin Daiyu creates space between them, and asserts her role as Xue Baochai's blade while expressing that she and Hong Lu weren't meant to meet again. She speaks poetically of the hurt she feels before making her leave. Notably, she described Hong Lu as someone she shared an intimate bond with, while Hong Lu only describes her as someone he'd had a brief connection with in his childhood.

During the second round of the Family Hierarch Evaluations, Lin Daiyu was separated from her faction by the closing walls, after which she spotted the nearby Sinners. Despite her initial distaste for the idea of an alliance, she joined Hong Lu in travelling due to the extra safety involved. Battling with her emotions the whole time, she attempted to understand Hong Lu's actions as a child, yet quiets herself in shame. While the group travels, she assists the group in combat, all the while viewing glimpses of Hong Lu's tormented past.

Suddenly realizing the reason for Hong Lu's changing personality, Daiyu's confrontation of him is short-lived as the group encountered Xue Pan, looking to get his revenge. After a short battle, his sister arrived which begins a new battle against Wang Dawei and Shi Yihua. Baochai willingly got left behind as she allows the Sinners to continue on with Lin Daiyu, acting as an extra set of hands to assist them. Finally witnessing the truth of the Kong family massacre, Lin Daiyu is left speechless over what her former friend had to experience. Even still, Hong Lu gave her empty platitudes about the changing state of the world.

While the group nearly made it to the central chamber of the battleground, a shot aimed at Hong Lu is blocked by Lin Daiyu, who leaped in the way. Gubo apologizes for the misfire, as Lin Daiyu is soon saved from the wound as Xue Baochai is eliminated, causing a Heishou Pack member to arrive and escort Daiyu out of the area, where she is given first aid.

After the success of the Sinners in the battle, and the emerging rise of Jia Xichun to hierarch, Lin Daiyu returned to meet the Sinners during the celebration, where Don Quixote and Gregor explain all that happened which she missed. As her master soon arrives to inform the group of the internal insubordination growing amidst the power vacuum, as well as the external forces, Lin Daiyu joined the working faction looking to save Jia Xichun from any threats aiming to eliminate her, taking to protecting Baochai from any threats.

As the Sinners engaged in brutal battle against Lei Heng, Jia Qiu arrived alongside Lin Daiyu, aiming to hold off the faction of the Thumb attacking the Tiekan Temple. When the Sinners return successful, the duo are exhausted, albeit able to defeat their enemies as Jia Qiu obliterates Lei Heng's skull. The group managed to flee, and later rightfully protect Hongyuan from the external factions and clans in disarray.

Days later, Lin Daiyu met with Hong Lu atop a pavilion. In a brief exchange, the two amicably came to understand one another and their past failings. Now, Lin Daiyu knows she can no long wait for change and truth to come to her, meaning she will soon likely leave Daguanyuan. Hong Lu, in a sense of newfound resolution, admits the day they flew kites together as children was his favorite day, to which Lin Daiyu agreed.

entries.name: Xue Pan
entries.content:
Xue Pan is a member of the Xue Family and a candidate of the Family Hierarch Evaluations. A known troublemaker in his family, he is a purveyor of Jar Monsters that he commands.

Xue Pan is a tall man with notably gray skin and piercing amber eyes. He has shaggy brown hair, which is longer on the back of his head, fashioned into long braids that coil across his entire body, with several orange bows tied across its length. He dons a miniature wuliu mian atop his head, with two sets of tassels on each side. He wears an amber robe, with wide sleeves revealing an inner lining of orange. Beneath a yellow sash at his waist, his clothes are covered in assorted talismans, similarly visible on the Jar Monsters he commands. He wears a set of loafers and wrappings on his legs.

As a child, he was still taller than the average youth. He wore similar clothing of a brown-orange robe, though his hair was much shorter, he did not wear a wuliu mian, and he did not wear the several talismans across his body.

Visibly unwell, Xue Pan is a deranged man who cares little for the wellbeing of others. He is willing to put others at risk for his own enjoyment, choosing to allow his Jar Monsters to attack other Family Hierarch Evaluations candidates, believing it to be something treasured and worth sharing, in a macabre sense. He is outwardly spiteful as well, threatening Hong Lu in the moments before round two.

Xue Pan is shown to have been much more meek in his youth, worrying about the dangers of Daguanyuan's practices and wishing to not participate.

As a child, Xue Pan feared the practices of Daguanyuan, once begging Jia Baoyu to save him from having to participate. Much to his chagrin, Jia Baoyu chose to not do anything that would save him from participating, creating a lifelong sense of distaste for Jia Baoyu.

Xue Pan was killed on several occasions in his life, causing gradual changes of his personality throughout his life. Xue Baochai alludes that this has always been an unsuccessful attempt to tame him.

Xue Pan was the 27th candidate of the first round of the Family Hierarch Evaluations. When called upon by Jia Zheng, he approached the podium rather than the designated platform area the candidates typically stood upon. Despite being told to move to the platform, he'd remain at the podium and place a talisman-covered jar down, from which Jar Monsters emerged. As the creatures began to attack the audience, slaughtering potential candidates, Xue Pan reveled in the chaos. Following a short battle with the Sinners, the creatures returned to their jars, to which Xue Pan requested the verdict for his solution to immortality from the judges in exchange for the clay from the jars. In response, he passed the first round.

As Hong Lu and the Sinners rode the elevator to the grounds the second round of the Family Hierarch Evaluations were to take place on, Xue Pan shouted a threat towards Hong Lu, determined to behead the Sinner.

During round two of the Family Hierarch Evaluations, Xue Pan inevitably encountered Hong Lu, motivated by his past spite towards the man over never being able to afford the same favor the gem of the Jia Family was awarded. Despite his hatred for the man, Hong Lu mentioned that, if possible, he would have given the favor to Xue Pan, only furthering his rage. Commanding Lin Daiyu to assist him taking down Hong Lu, he was ignored by her, leading to annoyance over her insubordination. Xue Pan attacked the Sinners alongside his Jar Monsters, only to be defeated shortly. Unwilling to allow this, he made a final attempt to stand up to his enemies, only to be cut short as he is killed and eliminated from the Family Hierarch war.

His death would be taken lightly by Xue Baochai, who knew he would just later be revived again.

Xue Pan has been revived a number of times via Life Insurance. While he initially recalls it as three or four times, he ultimately states that he no longer remembers.

entries.name: Wang Ren
entries.content:
Wang Ren is a member of the Wang family and a participant in the Family Hierarch Evaluations.

Wang Ren is a man with straight bangs, a small piece on the left side fastened aside by two horizontal hairclips. He wears black-rimmed circular glasses, and a brown-gray robe with a plaid pattern across it and elbow-length sleeves. On his right wrist, he wears a black bracelet, and carries a thick brown book in his left hand. Beneath his robes, he wears brown pants and similarly colored loafers.

Wang Ren is a spoiled man with little concern for others, looking to become the hierarch of Daguanyuan. He is shown to be meek, aiming to accomplish his goals without concern for the safety of others, such as endlessly offering blood to Bloodfiends in hope of achieving a faux immortality.

During the first round of the Family Hierarch Evaluations, Wang Ren would be the first to be called to demonstrate his answer to immortality. Mistakenly believing the Bloodbag he had acquired via Bloodfiend Hunters for an actual Bloodfiend, he presented the monster to the trio of judges, only to be told his answer was not sufficient. After a brief panic, attempting to explain how all one needs is blood to reach the immortality they crave, Don Quixote solemnly explains the downsides of life as a Bloodfiend. He is promptly dropped to his death, as the circular plate he and his Bloodbag stood upon is opened.

entries.name: Xue Baochai
entries.content:
Xue Baochai is a member of the Xue Family and Hong Lu's betrothed, as well as a candidate in the Family Hierarch Evaluations.

Xue Baochai is a woman of pale complexion, with droopy orange eyes and long, curly brown hair that reaches to her lower back. Her hair is partially worn in princess curls, tied up with orange flower ribbons, and she has blunt bangs. Baochai dons a qixiong ruqun, a high-waisted hanfu, composed of a pink top with orange detailing, and a skirt in peach tones, all sporting colorful flower decorations.

Around her neck, Baochai wears a jade pendant, that she began wearing after her betrothed Jia Baoyu's departure from Hongyuan, as a way to remember him.

Xue Baochai is a cheery and unbothered woman, unworried about the brutal practices of events such as the Family Hierarchal Evaluations, going as far as to participate herself. Despite her outward appearance of an energetic and kind lady, she has a vested interest in the dark and macabre, such as urban legends or the bloody stories of the Sinners' past encounters. She cares deeply for Hong Lu, willing to risk her life to alert him of dangers as well as protect him.

Sometime in the past, she would be put into an arranged marriage with Jia Baoyu. This was to her mother and grandmother's disapproval due to thinking lowly of the boy.

Xue Baochai had a great fondness for expensive perfumes and fragrances, upkeeping her scent on the daily through a rigorous routine. However, on a day where she hadn't the time to use these perfumes, Jia Baoyu commented on her fragrance, stating he quite enjoyed it. This stuck with Baochai until her adulthood, frequently citing it in her love for Baoyu.

Upon the return of Hong Lu to Daguanyuan, Xue Baochai quickly arrived to meet with her betrothed. Catching up with her absent fiancé, she drew his attention to the creation of her necklace, inspired by his jade eye. She was an exceptionally friendly face for the Sinners to encounter, and expressed curiosity over the tales of Hong Lu's adventure, particularly the bloody parts. After briefly discussing the situation regarding Jia Xichun, she checked with Hong Lu if he had encountered Jia Qiu during his travels, reaffirming the one-sided allyship he had held with Shi Yihua. Reminding Hong Lu she would always reside at Hongyuan, she departed from the dining hall.

Xue Baochai would participate in the Family Hierarch Evaluations, where she passed the first round—having been one of the many candidates shocked by Hong Lu's participation—and progressed towards the second round. She also made sure to congratulate Hong Lu for passing.

During the second round, she traveled with her clan only to stumble upon the Sinners; her bodyguard Lin Daiyu having traveled with the group due to getting lost. The group was soon forced into combat against a revived Shi Yihua, alongside the candidate Wang Dawei. Baochai, in an act of hoping to save Hong Lu and allow him to continue through the round, told him to leave as she would handle the enemy candidates. While her bodyguard accompanied her betrothed, her faction battled their foes until their collective eliminations, trapped by the closing walls nearby.

During the ceremony for Jia Xichun becoming hierarch, Baochai sheepishly approached the Sinners, skirting around a topic as she attempted to speak with them. Hurriedly, as Jia Qiu and his faction arrive, she explained the possible coup forming in the power vacuum before Xichun takes the throne. Her mother, the Xue and Wang families, lead by Jia Yuanchun, all internally looked to overthrow the ceremony; this was still not accounting for outside factions looking to enter the Wing. Fearing her mother would find out if she delayed any longer, she shortly departed.

Following the events of Canto VIII, Baochai is abducted by Yuanchun, who threatens her with the exposure of her insubordination to her mother. Xue Baochai, fearfully, accepts the threat, planning to assist Yuanchun in unknown matters if her help given to Hong Lu is not exposed.

entries.name: Xiren
entries.content:
Xiren is a maidservant serving the Jia Family, assigned to primarily serving Jia Baoyu.

Xiren is a woman with brown hair, with bangs parted down the center and hair tied into two small buns on the back of her head. She wears a gray hanfu with white sleeves, and dark red accents along the hems and center, beneath a similarly red sash. While her left arm is typical, her right arm has a green, plant-like, appearance, and her feet have been reshaped into hooves.

Notably, her younger self features none of these deformities, which were later caused due to extensive use of Boluses.

Hong Lu's trusted maidservant and caretaker through his childhood, Xiren always had a calm and collected personality, being always mindful of her young master's feelings. Xiren cared deeply for Hong Lu, and always attempted to shield him as best as she could from the cruel realities of Daguanyuan. Growing up, Hong Lu admired Xiren for her intelligence, as she seemed to always have an answer to everything; Jia Mu similarly comments on it after Xiren's attempt to discuss what she had been doing to her grandchild. Jia Mu also points out her naivety for not knowing her place, and believing she would be able to protect Hong Lu.

Following this act of insubordination, Xiren was executed by the Heishou Packs, and revived through Life Insurance technology. As Jia Baoyu's closest servant, no expense was saved for her, and she received the most expensive service available, which retained all of her memories, although her personality slowly changed, becoming colder and unaffected. This is later revealed to have been a conscious decision on Jia Mu's part, who revived her specifically as a more obedient, unfeeling servant, who would simply fulfill her duties and encourage Jia Baoyu to comply to Jia Mu and the Xianren's wishes.

Despite this, by the time of his return to Daguanyuan, Hong Lu views her as the same as she has always been, simply hoping her memories still bring her warmth. Before his departure, he asks her what she thinks of his decision to continue his journey, to which Xiren advises him to walk the path of his own choosing, which brings a smile to Hong Lu's face.

Xiren raised Jia Baoyu as his primary maidservant, taking care of him during his daily life. Xiren was by Baoyu's side during the times after the disappearance of Jia Ling, and attempted to shield him from the truth of what had happened to him, claiming that Jia Ling would be back after 100 nights.

During her time in his service, Xiren died multiple times; by making extensive use of Life Insurance, she was successfully revived with her memories intact. However, her personality slowly eroded, becoming emotionless as a result. When asked about Jia Ling again years later, she explained the matter, suggesting for Jia Baoyu to give up his naive hopes on the return of Jia Ling, as the poison affecting his absent sibling had caused brain death—something that neither Life Insurance nor Boluses could ever heal. As Jia Ling's maidservants gossiped of their master's inevitable point of no return, Jia Baoyu would reluctantly accept this reality and praise Xiren for her intelligence.

Upon the return of Hong Lu and Jia Xichun to Daguanyuan, Xiren returned to her master's side outside his childhood residency. After a brief reunion between Xiren and her master, she guided the Sinners to Hong Lu's room, where they were to pass the night.

Following the first round of the Family Hierarchal Evaluation, Hong Lu and the Sinners returned to his residency, where Xiren awaited them, having been delivered a letter for her master. Despite Ishmael realizing the letter had been tampered with, Xiren was resolute on only having only the responsibility to deliver the letter, rather than also keeping it from being handled by outside factions. Baoyu accepted this as if it was completely normal, explaining Xiren's situation to the rest of the Sinners when asked why he did so.

After Hong Lu had wrapped up his business in District 8, with Jia Xichun now hierarch, he had a final cup of tea alongside Xiren. Finally asking her how she feels of his departure, she gives an empty response. While Dante thinks the response is underwhelming, Hong Lu is comforted by this and smiled earnestly.

entries.name: Jia Yuanchun
entries.content:
Jia Yuanchun is an member of the Jia Family who married and moved to Q Corp., but has returned home to Hongyuan to act as a judge in the Family Hierarch Evaluations.

Jia Yuanchun wears a massive, ornate, gilded crown with two sets of red tassels on each side. Her black hair is partially tied upwards, while two low pigtails tied in gold bands fall down upon her chest, and two strands of hair fall around her eyes. She also has pink eyes with sharp lashes. She wears an ornate red robe with golden, flower-like accents, with a set of wide sleeves and hemline.

Jia Yuanchun is well-spoken and cautious, revelling in the status she has achieved in life. She is quick to worry about the past repeating itself, going as far as being ready to have Hong Lu killed to avoid history repeating. She has little issue with bringing harm to her siblings, as mentioned by Jia Xichun in her possible willingness to send assassins after them. She has a deceptive side, looking to topple the status of Hongyuan while it is at its weakest.

Jia Yuanchun returned to H Corp. to assist Jia Mu and Jia Zheng in judging the candidates competing in the Family Hierarch Evaluations. She evaluated many candidates in round 1, with most failing to present a worthy idea of immortality. When it was Hong Lu's turn to present immortality to them, the two exchanged a brief greeting, and she remarked on how strange it was to see him participating in the evaluations. Hong Lu then demonstrated his version of immortality to the judges and allowed himself to be killed by Ryōshū, which shocked all three of them. Yuanchun became distressed, not at the death of her brother, but in fear that he was attempting a resurrection that would be considered taboo under the Head. She was moments away from ordering Heishou Packs under her control to kill Dante and Ryōshū, hoping to prevent the Claw from destroying H Corp. once more, but Jia Mu stopped her and allowed the presentation to be completed. After Dante turned back the clock and Hong Lu was brought back without it seeming to break any taboos, Jia Mu declared that he had passed, and round one soon ended.

Briefly, Jia Yuanchun announced the winning results of the Family Hierarch Evaluations during a feast held to honor Jia Xichun. Her time here is brief as she quickly flees to make use of the power vacuum; as Xichun's position as Hierarch is technically yet to be officialized, she had planned alongside the Xue and Wang Families to organize a coup with the seat of Hierarch open. Her plans would, however, fail following Hong Lu's defeat of Jia Mu at Tiekan Temple and Xichun's proper ascent to the throne.

Her insubordination having fallen through, she had Xue Baochai, a dissenting voice of the plan, captured and taken to her. Yuanchun makes it known that while the Xue family was unaware of her status as an informant to Hong Lu, she could very easily shield her from the fallout and ascertain that her betrayal would never be discovered; all Yuanchun asks in return is her assistance in accomplishing a task.

entries.name: Hengwuyuan
entries.content: Xue Baochai's personal building / residence within Daguanyuan in Hongyuan.

entries.name: Lady Wang
entries.content:
Lady Wang is Hong Lu's mother and the wife of Jia Zheng.

Lady Wang has light skin and droopy, dark gray eyes. Her hair is a deep shade of purple, half-tied up with a number of white flowers adorning her head. She wears a deep turquoise hanfu with white ornamentation, and a skirt low enough to reach the floor, a flower pattern visible along one side of its trim. On top of her hanfu, Lady Wang wears a blueish-gray robe with large splits along its sides with a light green and white embroidery pattern of flowers spread throughout the garment.

Lady Wang is a caring mother towards Hong Lu, valuing him as a treasured jade due to his eye. She is a venerated member of the Jia Family and values this fact greatly, believing Hong Lu should disallow his compatriots from using his birth name of Jia Baoyu, worrying it may become "tarnished."

Upon the return of Hong Lu and Jia Xichun, Lady Wang and Jia Zheng welcome Hong Lu back to the estate. Despite being thankful to see her son return after all these years, she is expectant for him to depart once more some time soon, urging him to do so as soon as possible. She is also somewhat displeased to find that her son has taken on an alias while on his travels, but ultimately concedes after he explains that he wanted to avoid having his name devalued by being repeated too much.

entries.name: Jia Zheng
entries.content:
Jia Zheng is Hong Lu's father and husband to Lady Wang, as well as a prominent member of the Jia Family.

Jia Zheng is a pale man of average height. He has black eyes and long black hair, partially tied up in a bun secured with a silver xiao guan (小冠, xiǎo guān), and sports thin moustache and a goatee. He wears a teal colored hanfu and a darker beizi with pale decorations.

Jia Zheng is a caring father towards Hong Lu, valuing him as a treasured jade due to his eye. He is a venerated member of the Jia Family and values this fact greatly, believing Hong Lu should disallow his compatriots from using his birth name of Jia Baoyu, worrying it may become "tarnished." He worries of his son becoming sullied by the world, in ways that would ruin his status.

Upon the return of Hong Lu and Jia Xichun, Lady Wang and Jia Zheng welcome Hong Lu back to the estate. While Lady Wang is more emotional about their reunion and goes on to urge Hong Lu to leave again, Jia Zheng is more awkward and quiet throughout the conversation.

During the first round of the Family Hierarch Evaluations, Jia Zheng acted as a judge alongside Jia Mu and Jia Yuanchun, being responsible for calling forth each candidate, as well as announcing whether or not they'd passed. Despite his role as a judge, he failed to account for Hong Lu's unexpected arrival into the ceremony, though begrudgingly allows him to pass after successfully passing the first round's criteria.

During the second round of the Family Hierarch war, he was replaced as the host of the battle royale, due to worries of possible bias.

entries.name: Xianren
entries.content:
The Xianren are the Hongyuan elders that have inherited the Xianhuang Anamnaworm in the past, before passing it to their successor. Living inside of the sealed Tiekan Temple, they aim to experience entertainment to accommodate their extended lifespans, leading to the unwilling participation of Hong Lu, as they watch through his jade eye.

The venerated elders of Hongyuan, each Xianren was once a well-known Hierarch of the District. In the process of succession, each retiring elder passes the inherited Xianhuang Anamnaworm to the next elder, before being sealed within Tiekan Temple alongside the rest of the group, where they live with their own, unique, forms of immortality.

Located deep within Daguanyuan, the passageways to Tiekan Temple are winding and exceptionally exhausting, with few members even knowing of the path to it. At the gates of the temple underground, just beyond a decorated bridge over a small lake, is a massive jade slot in the center, a gateway only opened either when the Xianren themselves invite somebody, or by Hong Lu bringing his eye to the doorway.

The room is dark, with many ornate pillars and seatings around the center of the room, where a giant screen rests on the ground, giving a live feed of all that Hong Lu witnesses via his left eye. After the events of Canto VIII: The Surrendered Witnessing, the room becomes flooded and blue, disconnected from the outside world due to the flooding.

Each elder features a complete unique design from one another, embodying their use of different methods of immortality. In all cases, this involves them becoming grotesquely deformed.

Each Heishou Pack is said to have a respective Bolus known only to their respective Heishou-Xianren, a Xianren who created the recipe for their Boluses, and thus, their mutations. These Boluses are closely guarded secrets, with only the respective Xianren knowing of the process to create each Bolus. Because of this secrecy, it is near impossible to expand the groups of Heishou Pack members.

Not even Family Hierarchs are told of the recipe used to create the Heishou Pack branches.

Notable Elders include:

Bloodied Elder: One of the many Xianren, this elder is a figure composed of congealed blood, sitting on a small branch with his legs in a lotus position with his wrists crossed. His face features a coronal slice of a brain, with the skull similarly exposed with beady eyes and a large set of symmetrical antlers emerging from the sides of his head. Several budding branches emerge from his back, and stretch outwards behind him.

Wheelchair Elder: One of the many Xianren, this elder is a dark figure with wrinkled skin, appearing as if she has been completely drained of blood and an oxygen mask over her mouth. She has an elongated skull, sunken eyes, and long, claw-like fingers. Her bottom half is obscured in a bloodied robe, and she sits in a rusty wheelchair, featuring an attachment that carries six bags of blood, all of which are attached to various points across her body.

Prosthetic Elder: One of the many Xianren, this elder is only a torso and head, with just the right arm remaining. His skin is aged and patchy, while the mechanical prosthetics replace the missing sections. His brain and left eye are exposed, with a large red dot where his mouth would be, the rest of his head replaced by the sleek metal. Large tubes connect to his back, holding him upright, with his spine connecting to a glowing red platform beneath him.

Branch Elder: One of the many Xianren, this elder appears to have rotted flesh peeling back, revealing her teeth as her lips decay and an exposed brain. From her body, several branches sprout, such as from her right eye socket. She wears long, aged, white robes with three large circular pattern on its center and sides. She carries a tall branch that has similarly circular supports in the center of it.

Tube Elder: One of the many Xianren, this elder appears to simply be the overgrown head of an elderly man, with bushy eyebrows and moustache. He is within a tube full of red fluid, with many smaller tubes connecting to the top and bottom. Some tubes connect to his head, such as on his cheeks.

Slug Elder: One of the many Xianren, this elder looks like an overgrown slug, with vestigial limbs hanging limply on top of his huge body. He has green skin, which sags overtop the majority of his face. He wears a large dual set of brown robes with tan trims.

The first elder of Daguanyuan became an Anamnaworm, one which would be passed down across each following Hierarch in a mean to accrue exponential knowledge across each succeeding Hierarch. One of these elders was recognized by Jia Xichun as her great-great-grandfather, who once snuck her snacks and was known for his fondness for walks.

As the Xianren's lifespans were so long, they found that the true danger of immortality was boredom. As a way to combat this, on Jia Baoyu's birth, Jia Mu implanted a jade into his left eye, making him a treasured piece of Hongyuan's culture. In reality, this jade allowed for everything that Jia Baoyu experienced to be sent to a screen in the Tiekan Temple, to provide the Xianren with unique entertainment from within their chambers.

In Jia Baoyu's youth, he would be repeatedly summoned to the Tiekan Temple, where they would meet with him as a way to treasure him for his status as the "jade of Hongyuan", something which Jia Baoyu feared at first, yet grew apathetic and desensitized to. On some occasions, Jia Baoyu witnessed a 'molting' process, where the elders fed on unknowing servants, splitting their corpses between each member as means to remain living.

One event of which the Xianren were particularly fond of was the massacre of the Kong family, to which they grew especially fond of Jia Mu for having caused.

In a bid to continue creating new entertainment for the elders, Jia Mu had Jia Baoyu leave Daguanyuan, coinciding with when the man was contracted by Faust for Limbus Company. This would cause the Xianren to witness the events of every single Canto, growing fond of the Sinners from a detached point of interest.

Once Jia Xichun had managed to secure the role of H Corp. Hierarch, she was required to be annointed officially by meeting with the Xianren in Tiekan Temple, accepting the Anamnaworm, and then assuming the throne in Daguanyuan. The Sinners arrived to the temple while this was in the process of unfolding, where Jia Xichun grew terrified of the Anamnaworm, worried to become another immortality-obsessed Xianren who witnesses brutality through Hong Lu's jade. While the Xianren were initially joyful at meeting the Sinners in the flesh, they quickly grew annoyed at the insubordination against the passage of the Anamnaworm. Jia Mu battled the Sinners, utilizing the forbidden Hiexian Bolus to inherit the attributes of every Heishou Pack Branch. During this battle, she consumed several of the elders in a desperate plea to regain her footing against the Sinners, and harness the consumed elder's immortality.

At the climax of this battle, Hong Lu utilizes an empowered Land of Illusion to release a flood of clear water, knocking the Golden Bough embedded into Jia Mu's chest free and flooding the entire temple. As the Xianren are collectively knocked away from their seats, Jia Huan angrily approached the screen in the center of the building and shattered it. While several of the elders attempted to crawl out of the gateway of the temple, they were unable to, and were sealed within as Hong Lu wished them goodbye, permanently sealing them inside.

While the Xianren each utilize means of flawed immortality, their natural lifespans are extended. Without their sustenance, influence, or entertainment, Meursault hypothesizes they will soon pass naturally while locked within the chamber.

entries.name: Jia Mu
entries.content:
Shi Miyin, commonly referred to as Jia Mu, is the Hierarch of the Jia family and the former head of H Corp., known across the Nest for her outward benevolence and intelligence.

Jia Mu is an older woman of short stature, with pale, grayish skin and golden eyes. She has long white hair tied up with a golden ornament which reaches down nearly to her ankles. She wears a white and gold hanfu with golden decorations of plants and clouds. The hanfu is tied with a black and gold sash. She wears a pair of qiào tóu lǚ[1], colored dark gold with a three-leaved plant decoration. In the Tiekan Temple, she reveals the Xianhuang Anamnaworm embedded in the back of her neck, a small creature with the face of the ancient hierarch of Hongyuan.

After consuming the completed Heixian Bolus, her body rapidly mutates, generating multiple different animal parts. Her entire body grows massively, with her limbs outstretched far longer than her typical form. The animals that her body morphs into correlate to each of the Heishou Pack Branches.

Further deformed in her Distorted form, Jia Mu becomes quadrupedal and animalistic, her neck stretched further beyond what is normal. Her mutations tear her clothes, and she has a shrine-like palanquin, composed of dark wood, emerging from her back. Whilst pierced by the Golden Bough, the limbs of the bough stretch through her entire body and pierce the palanquin. Inside the palanquin, the Xianhuang Anamnaworm rests, peeking out from the window of the grotesque vehicle.

In her many years of living, Jia Mu has accrued a wealth of knowledge, displaying it in her wise and venerated way of living. She displays a particular interest in Hong Lu experiencing as much as possible in his life, having led to him leaving Daguanyuan in the first place. Despite this air of veneration, Jia Mu is a scheming woman with dark plans to enact her vendetta against others. She is cutthroat and uncaring to the deaths of others, supposedly keeping Hongyuan's best interest in mind, making such a note to even have Jia Baoyu witness brutality and deaths through means such as the massacre of the Kong family for the Elders' entertainment.

In the throes of her madness, exacerbated by the Heixian Bolus, Jia Mu becomes desperately frantic, attempting to honor the venerated Xianren while in a haze of delusions. She speaks of herself by her past name, Shi Miyin, referring to herself as a 'little girl'.

Jia Mu is stated to have a fondness for collecting unique creatures and specimen for a personal collection.
Among all of Hongyuan, Jia Mu is the most educated on the creation of Boluses.

Jia Mu would inherit the role of H Corp. Chief Executive Director sometime in the past, which she would use to cause a great rise in the power of the Jia Family, establishing an age of incredible scientific prowess. Utilizing sciences developed by the Kong family, Jia Mu worked closely alongside Kong Youjin and Sihui. Under the guise of creating a Bolus that would be used to create a new, powerful, thirteenth branch of the Heishou Packs, Jia Mu was given the family's unrestricted support for her efforts. In reality, Jia Mu aimed to create a Bolus which would propagate a species of monsters from the Outskirts, the Jiajia-ren. The emergence of an unrestricted external creature would violate a taboo established by the Head, who Jia Mu knew would come and destroy the Kong family, while allowing her to cover up the event as a scene of hubris. Throughout the entire process of deceiving the Kong family, Jia Mu insisted that Jia Baoyu accompany her, acting as a witness to all that happened.

Jia Mu had young Jia Baoyu witness grim sights he never wished to watch, such as the condemnation of prisoners and the unethical experiments performed on them. This would culminate on the day of the Kong family's presentation of Jia Mu's supposed new Heishou Pack Bolus, where Jia Baoyu was forced to witness the massacre of the whole family. Once the pregnant Kong Sihui's unborn child burst from her as a Jiajia-ren a slow descent began as havoc erupts, the arrival of the Head punctuating this. According to her plan, Jia Mu and Baoyu left untouched, even when an Arbiter was face-to-face with the two. Her plan had been a massive success, leaving almost none of the Kong family remaining.

Later, Jia Mu sent Hong Lu to witness as much of life across the City as he can, only to return once he has done so.

During Hong Lu's return to the estate, she briefly met with him. Accompanying his parents, she would stress the importance of him witnessing all that he could and that he should leave as soon as possible. However, Hong Lu, acting on the behalf of the wills of Limbus Company, refused to follow through with her request, where he then participates within the Family Hierarch Evaluations instead. In round one of the evaluations, she, Jia Zheng, and Jia Yuanchun acted as the judges, the three of them determining the authenticity of the many forms of immortality each participant had brought. Reminding Jia Yuanchun to be patient during Hong Lu's demonstration of his respective form of immortality, she passed her grandson onto the next round of the evaluations.

Within the second round of the Family Hierarch Evaluations, her machinations were revealed to the Sinners and Lin Daiyu due to the resonance of the nearby Golden Bough.

Following Xichun's successful acquisition of Hierarch status, she traveled to the Tiekan Temple to meet with the Xianren and claim the role of hierarch, which Jia Mu attended. As Hong Lu arrived to find a panicked Jia Xichun and the disfigured elders welcoming him back, Jia Mu presented the Xianhuang Anamnaworm used to inherit the past hierarchs when they relinquish their roles. She likewise presented a gift to Hong Lu: the Golden Bough. Despite the offer, Hong Lu rejects, not wishing for Jia Xichun to fall victim to the same gruesome fate as the Xianren, causing Jia Mu to become angered at his insubordination. Piercing herself with the Golden Bough and ingesting the forbidden Bolus, she battled the Sinners in anger over her control of Hong Lu slipping through her fingers, even Distorting partway through the fight. At the summit of the battle, Hong Lu experiences a massive growth to his E.G.O, allowing him to summon a torrent of flooding water that would smash against the elders, the water knocking the Golden Bough from Jia Mu's shoulder. In a fit of rage, she shouted hate at Hong Lu, who simply chose to leave the chamber. As the doors close, the Tiekan Temple is left isolated with the water severing a proper connection to the rest of Hongyuan, trapping Jia Mu alongside the elders inside.

While they were left alive, the group would be trapped in the area without any food, supplies, or entertainment. Due to their modified forms of pseudo-immortality, they would likely die at a slower rate than others, though they would one day die nonetheless.

entries.name: New League of Nine Littérateurs
entries.content:
The New League of Nine Littérateurs is a faction based in N Corp., led by Director Hermann.

The group was created as an attempt to reunite the former researchers of the League of Nine under a new lead, starting with the Littérateurs Gubo, Yi Sang, and Aseah; because of this, it took on the name of New League of Nine Littérateurs.

Its currently known members are the scientist Gubo, the researcher Aseah, Sonya of the Yurodiviye, the former Whaler Ahab, the former Chief Butler of the Edgar Family Nelly, and Huan of the Jia Family.

Their goals and methods appear to align with those of Limbus Company. The New League utilizes Abnormalities and is able to extract E.G.O from them, making use of N Corp. E.G.O in combat. Furthermore, the New League seeks to obtain the Golden Boughs located all across the City, although their goals appear to have a wider, though still mysterious, reach.

The goals of the New League of Nine Littérateurs are largely unknown at this time, though the faction expresses clear interest in the search for the Golden Boughs. The New League of Nine Littérateurs is heavily involved in the study of Mirror Technology and Mirror Worlds, with Hermann directing her researchers to find a way to destroy all the worlds and the possibilities reflected in the Mirror.[1] Whether this is the ultimate goal, or a milestone in the process of achieving said goal, is currently unclear.

The New League, particularly Hermann, also presents a recurring interest in creating a form of pure human,[2] which their experiments in Wuthering Heights aimed at creating through the use of an Identity system, and that is noted to be quite similar to the Imperial Worm of carried by the Hongyuan Hierarch.

Relations with other Factions: 

Yurodiviye
A Syndicate originating from Y Corp. that has slowly spread through all the Nests of the City. Its leader Sonya is connected to one of the Sinners, Rodion. Hermann had apparently tasked him with retrieving the Golden Bough at J Corp., though how deep their connection goes is currently unknown, given Sonya seems to also have ties with Demian's Group.

The Ring
Some time before the beginning of Limbus Company, the Ring kidnapped researcher Aseah, a member of the League of Nine from N Corp. Despite the circumstances, Aseah and Maestro Jumsoon developed a professional relationship with one another due to Jumsoon's fascination with the Mirror Worlds he could see using N Corp.'s Glass Window, aiding in Aseah's research as the two becoming mutual partners.

Due to the Syndicate's collaboration with N Corp., rumors spread across certain Wings and Grade 1 Fixers that the Ring Finger was observing an unknown Singularity.

Pequod Town
Ahab, having lost her mind following the death of her lifelong mark, the Pallid Whale, at the hand of Ishmael, is approached by Hermann, who rides in aboard one of her many affiliated battleships. Promising Ahab infinite amounts of Whales to hunt across all Mirror Worlds, she convinces the captain to join her, to put her resolve in Hermann's service.

Wuthering Heights
Hermann carried a certain interest in the River flowing beneath Wuthering Heights in Nest T, which she believed would help her research on the primordial human form. Having gotten in contact with the Butler Nelly, Hermann offered the lady of the house, the inventor Catherine Earnshaw a contract: with Catherine's collaboration in turning the manor's basement into a laboratory, Aseah and former Ring researchers began conducting Mirror World experiments, gathering human subjects with the help of Linton Edgar and turning them into "dough" to create "primordial humans". Following the events of Canto VI, the laboratory under Wuthering Heights has now become defunct.

Shi Family
During the Hongyuan Family Hierarch Evaluations of 985, the New League collaborated with the Shi family of Daguanyuan, having hired them to void the results in the case a Shi family candidate failed to win. In return, the New League would be taking a reward from the Daguanyuan treasury.

During Canto VIII, the New League member Jia Huan, accompanied by Gubo and a small faction, joins the Evaluation. While initially assumed to be after the Golden Bough located in the Daguanyuan treasury, the two are later revealed to have been planning to qualify third, and recover the Xianhuang Worm, the Imperial Anamnaworm carried by the Family Hierarch Jia Mu, a specimen that came incredibly close to Hermann's idea of humanity. The Anamnaworm was recovered following Jia Mu's defeat at the hand of Hong Lu: while it was in a weakened, dying state, Gubo believed it would suffice for their objectives.

Members:

Hermann - (Leader)
Gubo - (Member)
Aseah - (Member)
Jia Huan - (Member)
Sonya - (Member)
Ahab - (Member)
Nelly - (Member)

entries.name: Shi Family
entries.content:
The Shi family is one of the four great families of Daguanyuan. The current Family Hierarch Jia Mu, née Shi Miyin, descended from the Shi family: at the times of her grandfather, the Shi family was known to be one the most prestigious families of Hongyuan, towering even above the Jia family, although with time, they underwent a great decline. The Shi family seems to be known to be highly ambitious, yet lacking the qualifications and ability to maintain their power.

During the Family Hierarch Evaluation of 985, at least four members from the Shi family participated as candidates: Shi Yihua, who was decapitated by Jia Qiu and unable to participate to the first round but joined Wang Dawei during the second, Shi Dazhen, who failed to appear at the first round of the evaluation and was eliminated by default, Shi Huazhen and Shi Sijing, who were eliminated on the second round, defeated by Jia Baoyu's entourage.

Additionally, the Shi family hired the New League of Nine Littérateurs: their member Jia Huan would join the Evaluation and void the result in the occasion that a Shi family candidate failed to win.

After the second round of Evaluations and Jia Xichun's victory, the Shi family aligned itself with the Xue family and Jia Yuanchun to conspire against Hongyuan. It is suggested the same influential member of the Shi family that ordered Shi Yihua's execution was the one behind this.


Family:

Shi Miyin - (Former Family Hierarch),
Shi Huazhen - (Member),
Shi Sijing - (Member),
Shi Yihua - (Member).

entries.name: Xue Family
entries.content:
The Xue family is one of the four great families of Daguanyuan. The Xue family is known to be prestigious, with other houses such as the Lin family answering to their service. A prominent member of the Xue family is suggested to be Xue Pan and Xue Baochai's mother, who seems to be a strict woman with little regard for her children's lives. The lady Xue was also responsible for sending a group of assassins led by the Night Drifter after Jia Baoyu's clan on the night after the first round of evaluations.

During the Family Hierarch Evaluation, at least three members of the Xue family participated as candidates: the siblings Xue Baochai and Xue Pan, who both passed the first round, and a third member who was eliminated during the first round.

After the second round of Evaluations and Jia Xichun's victory, the Xue family aligned itself with the Shi family and Jia Yuanchun to conspire against Hongyuan. Notably, Xue Baochai went against this plan, personally warning Hong Lu of the conspiracy. After Jia Xichun's ascension, she was taken in by Jia Yuanchun with the purpose of discussing her betrayal to her family.

Family:

Xue Baochai - (Member),
Xue Pan - (Member).

Retainers (non-relatives):

Lin Daiyu - (Xue Baochai's servant),
Night Drifter - (Xue family assassin).

entries.name: Wang Family
entries.content:
